notifications.welcomeBody:
Here's a quick guide to get around:

• Home — Emergency card, Nearby care, Learn, and shortcuts
• Apps — Medication, vaccines, checkups, pregnancy, and period trackers
• Family — Household profiles and shared kids care
• Profile — Patient ID, settings, and preferences

This bell collects updates in one place. Explore at your pace — CareMate works offline too.
